review_type: Visual inspection of generated PNG files
observations: The Pages views at 390 and 1366 px show the title, the result sentence and the first-screen picture: two reader screenshots side by side, the passage with its note markers and Note 1 opened with its return links. At 390 px the picture is scaled to about 350 px, so its text is small.

The first-screen picture is two unedited 390 px reader screenshots; the first shows the opening passage and markers 1 to 6, the second shows Note 1 with its three return links and the start of notes 2 to 4. Other reader captures are linked.
Normal and enlarged reader text is legible. Wide text has a bounded reading measure; phone text wraps without horizontal scrolling.
The final return capture shows the highlighted marker in the last passage; preceding text scrolls normally within the reading viewport.
The case text states that Kindle device, Previewer, native popup and KDP acceptance were not tested.
No contact details, endorsements, client branding or invented commission claims were found in the manuscript or reviewed page content.
boundary: Offline local GitHub-style and Pages renders, not screenshots of published URLs. Visual review is separate from automated checks.
